selection: Frozen first-order utility-gain selector with four heads in one layer.
matched_control: At each attention row, swap the pair of distractor weights whose absolute gap is closest to the source-max transferred mass; apply the same interpolation alpha.
primary_estimand: Source interpolation minus displacement-matched distractor interpolation output-margin effect at each alpha.
success_rule: The hierarchical interval is positive at alpha 1, mean source-minus-control effect is nondecreasing over alpha, and alpha 0 is numerically zero. Alpha 0.25 is the preregistered near-natural diagnostic and is not required to pass.
interpretation_if_fail: Restrict the causal claim to the full fixed-spectrum endpoint and acknowledge that local paths do not support a smooth natural-failure account.
